result_summary: Completed an adversarial non-regression ledger for the Alumnos/teacher coordination surface. The dominant risk is not merely visual breakage: alumnos-teacher is not one authoritative physical page and project-alumnos remains canonically unbound, so swarm editing can silently collapse identities or inflate child-page authority unless target resolution, shared-owner boundaries and candidate truth ceilings are enforced. The ledger persists 12 protected invariants and 12 falsification journeys spanning authority, identity, shared Study ownership, José V11 learning-state behavior, mobile/input parity, PageKit selective adoption, annotation semantics, host-routed Page Change results, stale-write collision safety and human-courier avoidance.
material_advances: Converted recovered Alumnos/José/PageKit negative knowledge into a single reusable surface-level guardrail ledger rather than another redesign proposal.
Made the current root-binding ambiguity an explicit regression class: a live/recovered child surface cannot become the Alumnos root by inference.
Bound shared Study v1 ownership and its v2 migration rule into the pre-integration gate so swarm edits cannot solve local needs by creating a second shared Study implementation.
Preserved V11-specific educational invariants: four distinct Algebra topics, 12 levels per topic, 48 canonical exercises, non-destructive theory/practice coupling and small-phone/input-path behavior.

Preserved PageKit R07 capability distinctions: V26 rollback donor, V37 selective donor, pressed-only eraser, typed undo when adopting erase/object semantics, distinct tab models, and explicit NOT_EVIDENCED status for Wacom pressure/buttons and application Fullscreen.
Added system-level falsification for the human correction loop: a changed child file alone is insufficient if the result does not return durably through the Prometeo host/change-thread flow.
Added stale swarm overwrite falsification tied to the global mandatory prewrite protocol and exclusive ownership model.
Deduplicated follow-up work against the existing root-binding handoff and prepared Alumnos truth/intent/UX/reuse/discovery/plan/local-integration lanes; emitted no duplicate opportunity.
non_obvious_findings: The highest-risk failure mode is identity/authority collapse: a candidate can look visually correct while being structurally wrong because alumnos-teacher currently spans multiple separately-owned products and a still-unbound coordination root.

The missing root binding and the missing/desired human-facing page are different problems. Binding a coordination root must not choose José Study, Student World or PageKit as the page/product authority by inference.
A local Alumnos improvement can be a hard architecture regression even with perfect UX if it forks shared Study ownership or imports V37 wholesale instead of adopting only justified capabilities.

One-message human correction has a falsifiable UX contract beyond source mutation: durable return + host-preserving visibility is part of completion, otherwise the human becomes the courier of context/results.
preserved_invariants: Current, candidate, tested, Human Accepted and Served remain distinct.
project-alumnos root binding is not inferred from child-page presence.
Alumnos root, Student World, José Study, subject/class/atlas/homework and PageKit/Class Player remain distinct identities.
shared/study/current.json remains the single explicit Study UI owner; no duplicate shared Study implementation was created.
José V11 remains a LAB restart frontier, not a promoted product.
V26 remains a rollback/stability donor and V37 remains a selective capability candidate rather than a whole-product promotion.
No product bytes, Project Index, Current, Catalog, Lineage, Human Accepted or Served authority was mutated.

verification.falsification_tests_status_note: This lane is a read-only regression-risk critique. It defines executable falsification journeys for later mutation/integration lanes; it did not mutate product bytes and therefore does not claim those future product tests passed.

notes: The ledger treats the Alumnos root candidate as CANDIDATE_NOT_BOUND, not as current authority.
It does not infer the eventual primary human-facing Alumnos page from José Study, Student World or PageKit presence.
It distinguishes recovered/static evidence from runtime-proven capabilities, especially Wacom/Fullscreen.
It does not claim future falsification journeys have passed; they are gates for mutation/integration work.
The root-binding divergence is taken from current PROJECT_INDEX plus the fresh Alumnos truth return, not from chat memory.
